newsitem.title: UK: Cobalt to see greater stability - Roskill.
newsitem.headline: Cobalt to see greater stability - Roskill.

text.p: The overall outlook for cobalt is for a steady expansion of demand, a study published by Roskill Information Services said.
The study predicts an annual average rate of growth in demand of three to 3-1/2 percent a year to the end of the decade.

High prices for cobalt have encouraged the development of a number of new projects. The new supply is set to bring lower cobalt prices and greater stability, which should benefit the market in the long term.
"By the end of the decade there is likely to be greater stability in the market and prices will be close to $10 a pound," Roskill said.
